references.text: Numbers 33:9 also mentions Elim with its twelve springs and seventy palm trees, confirming Israel's campsite there.
The preceding account of Mara, where the water was bitter, stands in contrast to Elim's abundance of fresh water and palms.
Israel traveled on from Elim to the Desert of Sin, showing the route taken after staying at the springs.
The twelve springs may symbolize Israel's twelve tribes, which are listed here.
The seventy elders of Israel can be linked to the seventy palm trees as a symbolic number representing Israel's leadership.
Seventy elders were chosen to help Moses, linking the number seventy with leadership in Israel.
